description: Institutional quantitative crypto intelligence, cross-sectional momentum screening, Parkinson realized volatility regime detection, and liquidity analytics.
author: Ishant Panchal

tools.name: screener
tools.description: Execute institutional quantitative crypto market screens. Use `action` to select: momentum | volatility | liquidity | breadth | quote | funding | risk_parity | neutral_alpha | pairs_arbitrage | l2_depth.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: One of: momentum, volatility, liquidity, breadth, quote, funding, risk_parity, neutral_alpha, pairs_arbitrage, l2_depth.

parameters.name: top_n
parameters.description: Optional number of assets to return for momentum screen (1-100, default 10).

parameters.name: min_volume_usd
parameters.description: Optional minimum 24h USD volume threshold for filtering (default 50,000,000).

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Target ticker symbol (e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL) required for volatility, liquidity, quote, or l2_depth.

parameters.name: pair
parameters.description: Synthetic cointegrated pair (e.g. SOL/ETH, AVAX/SOL, NEAR/SUI, BTC/ETH) for pairs_arbitrage.
